class TestSupervisor(unittest.TestCase):
    # Duplicate physical IDs -> ValueError
    # Duplicate ports -> ValueError
    # Port <1024 or >65535 -> ValueError
    # SHA256 mismatch -> ValueError
    # Unsafe device chars (shell metacharacters) -> ValueError
    # Output root outside supplied root -> ValueError
    # Stale PID restart receipt -> UNKNOWN_INTERRUPTED, no reattach
    # Atomic JSON >128KiB -> ValueError
    # Cancel mid-startup -> CANCELLED state, teardown called
    # Fake launcher inject failure on port -> FAILED state
    # Fake launcher success -> READY then COMPLETED after deadline
    # Existing run directory -> FileExistsError
    # Job object assignment failure (Windows mock) -> FAILED, process killed
    # killpg containment failure (Linux mock) -> handled gracefully
notes: All artifacts untrusted until local review/gates.
No GPU imports used; standard library only (os,sys,json,hashlib,time,socket,tempfile,signal,subprocess,ctypes,ctypes.wintypes,re,unittest,pathlib,typing,enum).

Windows containment uses ctypes CreateJobObjectW + SetInformationJobObject(JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE=0x2000) + AssignProcessToJobObject. Disclaimer: CREATE_SUSPENDED+ResumeThread race elimination requires CreateProcessW directly because subprocess.Popen does not expose primary thread handle. This implementation assigns immediately post-spawn; if assignment fails, the process is killed (fail-closed). For production zero-race guarantee, replace subprocess.Popen with raw ctypes CreateProcessW(CREATE_SUSPENDED) -> AssignProcessToJobObject -> ResumeThread using PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_LIST or direct handle access.
Linux containment uses start_new_session=True + os.killpg for owned session teardown.
No shell=True anywhere; worker args are strictly [binary, --host, 127.0.0.1, --port, port, --device, backend_device].
TCP loopback check AND process alive required for READY; TCP alone is not GPU qualification per spec.
State machine: NEW->STARTING->READY->FAILED|CANCELLED|COMPLETED. READY means transport ready, not inference success.
Deadline always tears down owned trees/ports. No killing existing PID/port occupants outside our job/session group.
Journal committed sequence flushed via fsync. Restart receipt treats in-flight as UNKNOWN_INTERRUPTED, never reattaches/kills by stale numeric PID.
No KV/inference replay claimed. No service/global factory edits. No running workers now. No delegation claimed.
Manifest version 1 validated: 4 distinct physical IDs, 4 distinct ports 1024..65535, binary exists + hash verified, device safe chars only, output within supplied root.
Atomic JSON via tempfile + os.replace + fsync, bounded <=128KiB. Unique run dir refuses existing.
Direct API has no tools/children. Up to 10 native agents authorized but none delegated here.
